list: Official 55-trophy list as PlayStation publishes it, counts as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase

trophies.guide: The platinum has no task of its own: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Follow the roadmap in order — story, contacts, strangers, then the counted grinds — and let this one arrive last, as the final checkmark.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks with the last one.
Work the roadmap stages in order so no grind is left for the end.
Watch the tracker's progress bar — 54 of 54 is the trigger.

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Start a new game and play Gone Fishing from the first scene to the mission-complete screen — the trophy pops with the mission, and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission objectives to the end; there is no alternate route.
The trophy unlocks at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 1 finale. Play through the chapter's missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter's last mission ends and the next chapter begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 1 in story order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission to the end.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 2 opens.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 finale. Keep playing the story in order; the trophy is the chapter-complete reward, so there is nothing extra to do beyond finishing the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 2 in story order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission to the end.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 3 opens.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 finale. Same shape as the earlier chapters: play the story straight through and the trophy arrives when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 3 in story order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission to the end.
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 4 opens.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 finale and the last chapter trophy before the endgame. Finish the chapter's missions in order; the finale mission's ending triggers it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 4 in story order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission to the end.
The trophy unlocks as the final stretch of the story begins.

trophies.guide: The story finale, and the only gold trophy the story hands out. Finish the last mission of the campaign; the gold pops at the ending, and the platinum is then one step away.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play through to the final mission of the campaign.
Finish the final mission to its ending.
The gold trophy unlocks at the credits roll.

trophies.guide: A named story mission. Play Breakfast Run to its end — the trophy is the mission-complete reward, and missions can be replayed from the pause menu if anything goes wrong.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Start the mission Breakfast Run from the story.
Play it through to the mission-complete screen.
Replay it from the mission menu if the first attempt fails.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist, a named story mission. Finish it and the trophy follows; like every mission trophy it is the completion reward, not a hidden objective.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Start the mission The Cartel Heist from the story.
Play it through to the mission-complete screen.
Replay it from the mission menu if the first attempt fails.

trophies.guide: The mission Child's Play. Finish it to the end and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Start the mission Child's Play from the story.
Play it through to the mission-complete screen.
Replay it from the mission menu if the first attempt fails.

trophies.guide: The mission Headliners. Finish it and the trophy is yours at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Start the mission Headliners from the story.
Play it through to the mission-complete screen.
Replay it from the mission menu if the first attempt fails.

trophies.guide: The mission VCIA Takedown, set at the Vice City airport. Finish it to the end; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Start the mission VCIA Takedown from the story.
Play it through to the mission-complete screen.
Replay it from the mission menu if the first attempt fails.

trophies.guide: The mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish it and the trophy follows at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Start the mission Operation Savage Glory from the story.
Play it through to the mission-complete screen.
Replay it from the mission menu if the first attempt fails.

trophies.guide: The 100% gold. The in-game stats screen tracks completion across story, strangers, collectibles and activities — every category in this guide counts toward it. Finish the last open item and this gold pops with it.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Open the in-game stats screen to see which completion categories are open.
Work the guide's stages in order; every category feeds the 100% count.
The gold unlocks when the last category reaches 100%.

trophies.guide: 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the game's jumps, near-misses and airtime moments — they accumulate across all play, so drive fast, take ramps and keep moving. The count is tracked on the stats screen.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Play normally and attempt stunts: jumps, ramps, near-misses and airtime.
Check the running total on the stats screen as you go.
Keep at it until the counter reaches 250.

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types across Leonida, one try each. Races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting, drone races, shooting range and the rest — sample one of each type and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list and note the nine types.
Try one of each type, even briefly.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold time or score — learn the target pattern, then run it clean. The range tracks each challenge separately, so work through them one at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Open the Shooting Range and pick a challenge.
Learn its targets, then run it for the gold medal threshold.
Repeat for all 42 challenges; the silver pops with the last gold.

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: A Top Fun drone race win at each of the 14 locations. Drone races reward tight lines and throttle control — learn each course's turns, then win it once and move to the next location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Race the course and win it once.
Repeat at all 14 locations; the trophy pops with the last win.

trophies.guide: Twenty different races won. Any race type counts, but each race only counts once — variety is the requirement, so spread your wins across the map instead of repeating one favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Pick a race you have not won yet.
Win it; each distinct race counts once.
Win 20 different races in total.

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: A fishing challenge against Cal. Take the challenge, out-fish him, and the trophy pops at the result screen. Fishing rewards patience — wait for the bite, then reel steadily.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find Cal and take his fishing challenge.
Out-fish him in the challenge.
The trophy pops at the challenge result screen.

trophies.guide: One arcade game completed. Find an arcade cabinet, start any game, and play it to its end — completion, not a high score, is what counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida.
Start any arcade game and play it through.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's last mission. Play through Andy's mission strand in order; the finale mission's completion triggers the trophy. Contact strands unlock as the story advances.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Play Andy's missions in order as they unlock.
Finish his final mission to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's last mission. Play through Kenton's strand in order; the finale mission's completion triggers the trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Play Kenton's missions in order as they unlock.
Finish his final mission to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's last mission. Play through Billy's strand in order; the finale mission's completion triggers the trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Play Billy's missions in order as they unlock.
Finish his final mission to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map — meet them, play each strand to its end, and the silver pops with the eighth. Some strands only open after story progress, so check back as the story advances.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Watch for stranger markers on the map as you travel.
Play each stranger's strand to its end.
Complete 8 strands in total for the silver.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's last mission. Play through Randy's strand in order; the finale mission's completion triggers the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Play Randy's missions in order as they unlock.
Finish his final mission to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's last mission. Play through Tyrone's strand in order; the finale mission's completion triggers the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Play Tyrone's missions in order as they unlock.
Finish his final mission to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places — sit, meditate, and the spot counts. Work through them county by county so none is left for the end.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Find a meditation spot and meditate there.
Move to the next spot; each one counts once.
Meditate at all 18 spots.

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: A unique animal hunted for Bret. Take Bret's hunt, track the animal it names, and take it down cleanly — the trophy pops when the hunt is handed in.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunting request.
Track the unique animal it names.
Hunt it down and complete the hand-in.

trophies.guide: Three complete Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect a full set, then two more. Sets are tracked in the collection screen, so check which cards are missing before hunting blind.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Check the collection screen for which cards are missing.
Collect the cards of one set to complete it.
Complete 3 full sets for the silver.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are spread across the whole state — use the in-game map markers and work through them region by region; the counter tracks each location once.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Find a WAiNK location and use it.
Move region by region so no area is skipped.
Reach 100 locations for the silver.

trophies.guide: Fifty challenges completed. Challenges are the game's small open-world tasks — they accumulate across everything you do, so play widely and the counter climbs. The stats screen shows the running total.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Play across activities, driving, combat and exploration.
Watch the challenge counter on the stats screen.
Reach 50 completed challenges.

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Missable in practice: it needs your partner beside you. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape together — the trophy pops when the heat dies with both of you free. Do it during a partner story beat, when your partner is guaranteed to be present.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Be with your partner during a story beat that keeps them beside you.
Raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and escape together until the wanted level clears.

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Missable in practice: three shops in a row, with your partner, without ever losing the wanted level. Plan a route of three close shops, rob them one after another, and keep moving — stopping or losing the heat breaks the chain. Do it while a partner is with you.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Be with your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first, then the second, then the third without stopping.
Keep the wanted level alive through all three robberies.

trophies.guide: One hundred vehicles discovered. Every distinct vehicle you drive counts once — variety is the requirement, so drive everything you find instead of sticking to one favourite. The vehicle list tracks what you have discovered.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive any vehicle you have not discovered yet.
Each distinct vehicle counts once toward the total.
Discover 100 vehicles.

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Five enemies down in one Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group, wait until five are in view, then trigger Combat Focus and drop them all before it ends — grouped enemies in an open area make it far easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a group of five or more enemies in an open area.
Trigger Combat Focus with all five in view.
Take down five before the focus ends.

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Missable: an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport. Get to VCIA, take a plane, and leave without a flight plan — the trophy is tied to that one departure, so do it the first time you have a plane at the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Get to VCIA with access to a plane.
Take off without a scheduled flight — an unscheduled departure.
The trophy pops as you leave airport airspace.

trophies.guide: The Rhino tank. Get into a Rhino and use it — survive the heat it draws and the trophy pops. Tanks draw heavy attention, so pick your moment and keep moving.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Get into a Rhino tank.
Use it in the open and survive the response it draws.
The trophy pops once the tank run is done.

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable because the clean run is the point: rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — one detection and the attempt fails.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Avoid cameras and staff sightlines throughout.
Take the goods and leave undetected.

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults robbed, each with an escape. Vaults are the big jobs — plan the entry, crack the vault, then get clear before the response closes in. Each completed vault-and-escape counts once.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find a bank vault and plan the entry.
Rob the vault, then escape the response.
Repeat for 5 vaults for the silver.

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: One armored truck robbed, with an escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take its cargo, then break away before the response arrives — speed matters more than firepower here.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Take its cargo.
Escape the response for the trophy.

trophies.guide: All 52 areas of Leonida explored. The map tracks each area as you enter it — drive the whole state, county by county, until every area is filled in. The map screen shows which areas are still blank.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive into each area of Leonida; the map fills in as you go.
Check the map screen for blank areas.
Explore all 52 areas.

trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One illegal operation robbed from each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations — hit one per gang and the trophy pops with the ninth. The gangs are tracked separately, so check which ones are still open.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation belonging to a gang.
Rob it; each gang counts once.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it with the view — the trophy pops when the drink is served with the ocean in front of you.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail.
The trophy pops as you drink with the view.

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Missable: a showroom smash is a one-time moment. Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way back out through the glass in classic style — the trophy is the exit, so commit to it once you are inside.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom.
Smash your way out through the front in classic style.
The trophy pops on the exit.

trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable because it is tied to a specific place and moment: the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to the alley, play a frame, and follow through — do it while the alley is open to you in the story.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a frame and follow through.
The trophy pops at the alley.

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one comes from playing the partnership well — keep your partner happy and the moment arrives on its own as the story and activities unfold.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play partner activities and keep the partnership strong.
Watch for the partnership moment the description points to.
The trophy pops when the moment lands.

trophies.guide: Choices made — PSN tracks a count to 500. The game counts the choices you make across the story and the open world; keep playing and choosing and the counter climbs to 500 on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Keep playing and making choices across the story and world.
Watch the tracked count climb toward 500.
The trophy pops at 500 choices.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something once, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is the retry that works. Any retryable moment counts; the point is the second attempt landing.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an attempt at something retryable.
Try it again right away.
Succeed on the second try for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd events in its corners — wander, look closely, and the strange thing finds you. The trophy pops when you witness it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and hidden spots.
Watch for the strange event the description hints at.
The trophy pops when you witness it.

trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by that bowls them over. Get in a vehicle, get close, and take someone down with a melee attack from the moving vehicle — the drive-by is the trick, not the weapon.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get in a vehicle and find a target on foot.
Drive close and strike with a melee attack from the vehicle.
The trophy pops on the drive-by.

trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: $250,000 earned laundering Marked Bills through contacts. Marked Bills come from jobs — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the earnings accumulate. Keep laundering until the total hits $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from jobs.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.guide: $100,000 spent across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, food, weapons, vehicles — so spend as you play and the total climbs. The stats screen tracks spending.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend money in shops as you play.
Every shop counts toward the total.
Reach $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: All 8 garage properties purchased. Garages are bought as you earn money — buy each one as it becomes available and the trophy pops with the eighth.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Earn money through jobs and activities.
Buy each garage property as it opens up.
Purchase all 8 garages.

trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Ten vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, register them in the app, and the counter climbs — any ten distinct vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find a vehicle and register it in the Scooter Bros app.
Repeat with different vehicles.
Register 10 vehicles.
